data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross strengthening of $63.984 million in prior year claims provisions, representing 13.70% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development is attributed to a challenging period with high loss activity from 2017-2019, including natural catastrophes, man-made large losses, and the ongoing COVID-19 global pandemic.

challenging period for insurers and reinsurers through the high loss active years 2017-2019.

data.data_quality_notes: The narrative on page 2 mentions a 'favourable improvement in 2018 and prior year loss reserves' which contributed to the 2018 YOA profit, but the 'Change in prior year provisions' in the Technical Provisions note on page 17 indicates an overall gross strengthening for all prior years. The figure from the Technical Provisions note is used as the authoritative source for total prior year development.
